source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Board B of the Singles Event Companion is for Purge the Foe against Priority Assets. The Purge the Foe player plays Destroyer's Wrath and the Priority Assets player plays Vital Link. The app pairs this board with the Search and Destroy deployment. Neither disposition fixes the Attacker or Defender role; a roll-off settles that. Every zone, territory, objective and terrain position comes only from the official board image, and this entry states no measurements. Its lettered terrain pieces refer to the parts of the Battlefields: Armageddon kit.
